decisions.reason: We would keep the coolant pressure booster system because it remains tightly aligned with our established coolant-management business, and without evidence of results falling below internal or peer aspiration levels our organisational slack supports continued commercialization.

We would keep the coolant cleaning centrifuge since it fits our core offer, complements customer process efficiency, and there is still no clear signal of performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search or withdrawal.

We would keep the scraper belt chip conveyor, but monitor it closely, because it is more adjacent than core products even though its survival so far suggests it is not underperforming enough versus aspirations to justify redeploying resources yet.

We would keep the hinged belt chip conveyor for now because it remains a plausible adjacent extension of our automation and material-flow business, while no strong evidence of results below aspiration levels currently warrants dropping it.
